system.description:
ETHEREAL FOCUS SCREE TECHNIQUE

The light within you is more than biological. When deliberately awakened, it becomes a beacon to the living and a ward against things that should not walk among them.

Prerequisites Hotaru Heritage, Level 5

Action 1 AP; Duration 1 minute

Your Living Lantern intensifies. You shed bright light within 20 feet and dim light for a further 20 feet. While within the bright light, you and your allies gain a +2-circumstance bonus to Perception, Occultism and Religion checks made to detect, identify or understand spirits, haunts, possession and other manifestations involving the boundary between the mortal and spirit worlds.

Furthermore, you and your allies within the bright light also gain a +1-circumstance bonus to saving throws against possession and effects created by spirits or haunts.

Automated: press Use: 1 AP and its Focus use. For 1 minute you shed bright light within 20 feet and dim light 20 feet further (your token's light, and the light level: +3 steps within 20 feet, +1 beyond). You and your allies within 20 feet carry two ticks: +2 circumstance on Perception, Occultism and Religion about spirits, haunts and possession, and +1 circumstance on saves against possession and spirits' or haunts' effects. A save cannot see that its source is a spirit (spirit is a trait, not a creature type), so both are ticks.

conditionals.label: Spirit Beacon
conditionals.scope: Perception, Occultism or Religion to detect, identify or understand spirits, haunts, possession or the boundary between the worlds — tick if so

conditionals.label: Spirit Beacon
conditionals.scope: Saving throws against possession or an effect a spirit or haunt created — tick if so
